messages:
Emily: Heads-up team — Aquila Systems preview kicks off next week. They've shared NDA and a small set of hardware images for us to run microbenchmarks on. Need volunteers for infra, harness, privacy review, and on-call coverage. Goal: validate perf on their silicon + collect deterministic telemetry for later announcement. Timeline: 2-week EAP. Please reply with what you can take. :rocket: NDA link: https://internal.redwood/ndas/aquila-eap (partners@ already copied).

Raj: I can own provisioning + network/RBAC. Will need partner SSH keys and the list of allowed IPs. Who has the creds?

Marta: I’ll take the benchmark harness and result aggregation. Need clarity on target metrics we should record — p50/p95 latency, tokens/sec, model memory, KV cache hit rate, and simple quality checks. Will set up a canonical script.

Emily: Good list. Also capture cost tokens and failed-token rates. For quality we’ll run 3 prompt suites (safety, summarization, retrieval-style). Partners provided sample prompts at that NDA link.

Jordan: Are they giving us quantized builds or just FP16? We should know if conversion is required for our runtime.

Marta: They provided FP16 and an int8 artifact. We'll need to run a conversion pass for runtime compatibility. Quick conversion example I’ll put in the harness: 
```
python tools/convert_aquila.py --input aquila_fp16.pt --quantize int8 --out aquila_q8.bin
```
Also will produce a small sanity test to verify logits match within tolerance.

Raj: I'll create a dedicated pool called aq-preview-1 (3x A100 initially). I'll also set up a canary route for comparison. Partner keys: @Emily can you DM me the key files or point me to the secure bucket?

deploy-bot: Secure bucket created: s3://redwood-aquila-eap-telemetry — access granted to partners/aquila-eap and redwood/partnerships. Artifact upload path: s3://redwood-aquila-eap-telemetry/artifacts/

Kevin: I’ll be on-call for the runs and help with log collection and profiling. Ping me before you start long jobs.

Marta: Proposed run plan: Thu 09:00 PT — short smoke (10 min), Thu 10:30 PT — full microbench (2h), Fri 08:00 PT — regression quality suite (30m). Will post a spreadsheet for results and a short README for run steps. Anyone needs changes?

Emily: Sounds good. Also want to test routing: Dedicated vs Hosted fallback to compare tail latency under identical loads. @Raj can you set a canary to route 20% traffic to aq-preview-1 and 80% to hosted so we can compare?

Raj: Yep — will add route config: 
```json
{
  "route": "/v1/models/aquila-preview",
  "variants": {
    "dedicated": "aq-preview-1",
    "hosted": "redwood-default"
  },
  "split": {"dedicated": 20, "hosted": 80}
}
```
I'll post the actual config in this thread once provisioned.

Jordan: Quick privacy reminder: NDA clause 3.2 restricts sharing raw user prompts. We'll redact or hash prompt text before uploading telemetry. Marta, include a redaction step in the harness.

Marta: Will do. Example redaction command in harness: 
```bash
cat results.json | jq '[.[] | {id: .uid, metrics: .metrics, model: .model}]' > redacted.json
```
That way we keep UID and metrics only.

Emily: Volunteers summary: Marta (bench harness + redaction), Raj (infra + routing), Kevin (on-call + profiling), Jordan (privacy review), Emily (partner comms). If anyone else wants in, reply here. Quick sync tomorrow at 13:30 PT in #partnerships to finalize run times.

Kevin: I'll be there, will bring the latency profiler and a small parser I wrote for token-level breakdowns.

Emily: Thanks everyone — I'll circulate the NDA checklist and the shared spreadsheet after this.
